channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: A munição de Lula para o debate na Band
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's Globo interview shaped Lula's strategy for the Band debate, potentially adopting a confrontational tone. The Lula campaign adjusted its messaging based on statements from the Senate candidate.

item.title: Se eleito, Flávio subirá rampa do Planalto com Bolsonaro, diz Nikolas
item.description: At a campaign event in Vitória (ES), federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira claimed that Flávio Bolsonaro will ascend the Palácio do Planalto ramp alongside his father, Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio was joined by figures such as Tarcísio de Freitas and Lorenzo Pazolini, and has additional campaign events scheduled for the same day in Salvador (BA).

item.title: Datafolha: redução da maioridade penal tem apoio de 89% dos eleitores de Flávio e 70% dos de Lula
item.description: A Datafolha survey reveals that 89% of Flávio Bolsonaro's voters and 70% of Lula's supporters back lowering the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16. Voting intentions for the 2026 runoff show Flávio at 47% and Lula at 45%.

item.title: TSE manda Meta garantir isonomia a campanhas depois de falha em IA
item.description: TSE minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze banned Meta from restricting electoral publications of presidential candidates, ensuring equal treatment in campaigns. The decision responds to a PT lawsuit alleging AI failures that limited content about Lula while allowing it for Flávio Bolsonaro. The company faces a daily fine of R$500,000 for non-compliance.

item.title: Edinho Silva defende votar PEC da Segurança e debater maioridade depois
item.description: Edinho Silva, national president of the PT, advocated for the approval of the Public Security Constitutional Amendment and the creation of the Ministry of Public Security, emphasizing greater coordination among government branches to combat organized crime. He stated that the reduction of the age of criminal responsibility should be discussed later, and criticized proposals against ammunition tracking, such as the one defended by Flávio Bolsonaro, for benefiting organized crime.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que Lula quer ‘confronto direto’ e tentará ‘desmascarar’ Flávio em debate
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva stated that Lula will seek direct confrontation with Flávio Bolsonaro in the Band debate to expose lies and highlight political project differences. Lula's strategy focuses on social proposals and criticism of Flávio's austerity measures, with preparation led by Sidônio Palmeira and support from journalist Olga Curado.

item.title: Novo vai ao TSE para tentar barrar shows de apoio a Lula
item.description: The Novo Party filed a lawsuit with the TSE to block the Ato Musical pela Democracia, featuring performances by Caetano Veloso, Djavan and other artists supporting Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The motion claims the events constitute illegal electoral campaigns and demands details on funding, contracts and payments. The party also requested documents on the event organization and set a potential fine of R$ 100,000 for non-compliance.

item.title: Datafolha: mudança motiva voto em Flávio, e proteção social é a principal razão dos eleitores de Lula
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 41% of Flávio Bolsonaro voters cite desire for change and power alternation as their main motivation, while 48% of Lula voters highlight social protection. Rejection of Lula and PT ranks as the second most cited reason among Flávio's supporters.

item.title: Aliados avaliam que Lula se comportou como presidente em vez de candidato em sabatina na Globo
item.description: Lula's allies believe he missed an opportunity during his TV Globo interview by acting like a president rather than a candidate. They argue his institutional tone may have distanced voters looking for more assertive campaign messaging.

item.title: Flávio dança ao som do funk “petista disfarçado” em Vitória; assista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro danced to the funk song 'petista disfarçado' during a political rally in Vitória, attended by allies such as Nikolas Ferreira and Tarcísio de Freitas. The performance was recorded and shared on social media, sparking discussions about the use of musical content in political events.

item.title: 2ª semana pós-1º turno tem reação de Lula e Flávio em alerta
item.description: The second week after the first round showed a numerical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with 50% of valid votes each. Lula regained ground through grassroots mobilization and the approval of ending the 6x1 work schedule, while Flávio lost momentum and faces internal campaign challenges. The race is balanced again, with both candidates needing to redefine strategies for the second round.

item.title: ‘Não dá para tudo ser resolvido no confronto entre lulismo e bolsonarismo’, diz cientista político
item.description: Political scientist Marco Aurélio Nogueira criticizes the polarization between left-wing and right-wing politics, advocating for dialogue and bridge-building to overcome the institutional crisis in Brazil. He emphasizes that democracy requires constant care and condemns both Lula's strategy and Flávio Bolsonaro's anti-system discourse.

item.title: Canal "Exército do Lula" chega a 5 milhões de seguidores e Janones comemora
item.description: The 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel reached 5 million followers, celebrated by André Janones, who proposed that Lula engage directly with participants. The initiative aims to boost the campaign's communication, though the TSE attempted to suspend the channel over disinformation claims, which was rejected by its technical team.

item.title: O conselho que Toffoli recebeu para isolar ministros no cabo de guerra dentro do TSE
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Dias Toffoli has been advised to distance himself from ministers critical of the government within the TSE, aiming to consolidate a majority favorable to President Lula's administration. The TSE is divided between government-aligned factions and critics, with controversial rulings such as the suspension of the 'Exército de Lula' channel, organized by André Janones, causing internal conflicts. This division reflects intense debates on freedom of expression and electoral disinformation.

item.title: Ex-ministros de FHC e nomes de centro-direita assinam manifesto pró-Lula
item.description: Former FHC ministers and center-right figures signed a pro-Lula manifesto, warning against Flávio Bolsonaro. The document emphasizes support for institutional balance and social achievements, despite disagreements with the administration.

item.title: Datafolha: eleitores de Flávio dizem buscar mudança; os de Lula, proteção social
item.description: Datafolha poll shows technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (47%) and Lula (45%) in the second round, with Flávio's voters motivated by change and power alternation, while Lula's supporters prioritize social protection and legacy. In valid votes, Flávio leads 51% to 49%.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chama pai de 'professor' em ato com Tarcísio no Espírito Santo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) referred to Jair Bolsonaro as 'professor' during an event in Espírito Santo with Tarcísio de Freitas, emphasizing the former president's legacy and influence on Brazilian politics. The statement reinforces the PL's alliance ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro realiza ato no ES com milhares de apoiadores ao lado de Nikolas e Tarcísio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held campaign rallies in Vitória and Salvador as part of the 'Bloquinho do 22', gathering thousands of supporters dressed in green and yellow. Accompanied by Tarcísio de Freitas and Nikolas Ferreira, he emphasized victory in the runoff and made references to Jair Bolsonaro. The events featured musical parades, political jingles, and expressions of campaign support.

item.title: Em entrevistas, Flávio e Lula citam propostas econômicas que não cabem nas contas do governo, dizem analistas
item.description: In interviews with Globo, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro promoted economic proposals criticized by analysts for not aligning with the government's fiscal reality, ahead of the election's second round.

item.title: Exército do Lula: canal de Janones chega a 5 milhões de seguidores
item.description: The 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, managed by federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG), surpassed 5 million followers, mobilizing Lula's supporters in the final stretch of the 2026 elections. Using military-style language and engagement messages, the channel faced TSE decisions over misinformation suspicions, but the suspension was reversed. The strategy aims to increase digital participation among followers in the campaign against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro participa de "bloco" no trio elétrico em Vitória (ES)
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro took part in an event on Vitória's waterfront (ES), promoting a 'block party' during a sound truck rally with supporter support. He was accompanied by federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira, São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, and Espírito Santo gubernatorial candidate Lorenzo Pazolini. After the event, he will head to Salvador (BA) for another campaign stop.

item.title: Novo pede para TSE barrar atos musicais em apoio a Lula
item.description: The Novo party requested the suspension of musical events supporting Lula in the 2026 elections, claiming they constitute illegal campaign rallies. The petition seeks to ban the artistic performances and demand transparency regarding event costs and funding. Artists such as Caetano Veloso and Daniela Mercury are reportedly involved in the shows.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula se mobilizam nas redes e publicam fotos com camisa da seleção brasileira
item.description: Lula's supporters mobilized on social media by posting photos wearing the Brazilian national team jersey and making the 'L' hand gesture, a symbolic move to reclaim national symbols like the yellow shirt previously linked to Bolsonarism. The campaign included celebrities and was amplified through Lula's official Instagram posts, as he prepares for his upcoming debate against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Plano de Flávio para levantar R$ 200 bilhões retoma apostas frustradas de Meirelles e Guedes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's plan to raise R$200 billion through federal properties and debt securitization mirrors strategies previously attempted by Meirelles and Guedes with limited success. Documents from the TCU and the former Ministry of Economy show that asset sales and debt conversion face legal and operational obstacles, as well as low buyer interest.

item.title: Cidade da Grande BH reflete polarização entre lulismo e bolsonarismo
item.description: In the city of Guarulhos, in Greater São Paulo, 72-year-old voter Elizabete Oliveira Gregório reflects the polarized landscape of the 2026 elections, maintaining her unwavering support for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), whom she has voted for since 1989. Her journey, shaped by exposure to Lula's ideals upon moving to the city, illustrates the persistence of Bolsonarismo as an opposing force in the region.

item.title: Datafolha: eleitores de Flávio dizem votar por mudança, e os de Lula, por proteção social
item.description: Datafolha survey shows that voters for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are motivated by a desire for change and power alternation, whereas Lula (PT) supporters prioritize social protection, performance and legacy. The poll was released shortly before the 2026 runoff election.

item.title: Municípios com maior abstenção são em estados onde Lula perdeu para Flávio no 1º turno
item.description: The municipalities with the highest voter abstention in the first round of 2026 are located in states where Lula lost to Flávio Bolsonaro. The PT campaign focuses on mobilizing voters only where Lula leads, especially in the Northeast, to attempt an unprecedented turnaround in the second round.

item.title: Defesa de Vorcaro pede investigação de vazamento de conversas
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro's defense requested an investigation into the leaking of private conversations related to the Master case, claiming public lynching and privacy violations. Vorcaro, detained since March, is under investigation for alleged financial frauds at Master and the attempted purchase of the institution by Banco Regional de Brasília.

item.title: Como a Globo criou a maior fake news da campanha presidencial
item.description: Globo spread a false news claiming Flávio Bolsonaro intended to remove Our Lady of Aparecida as Brazil's patron saint, which was denied but went viral on social media. Left-wing politicians like Erika Hilton and Ivan Valente amplified the rumor. The network later apologized to viewers.

item.title: Se eleito, Flávio Bolsonaro promete Brasil entre as 7 maiores potências
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, promised to move Brazil from 10th to 7th place in the world's largest economies ranking, according to IMF data. In a speech in Vitória (ES), he emphasized restoring 'Brazil's dignity' and was accompanied by figures like Nikolas Ferreira and Tarcísio de Freitas. Bolsonaro also highlighted campaign activities in the state and held events in Salvador (BA) with supporters.

item.title: TSE nega remoção de vídeo que chama Flávio Bolsonaro de 'mentiroso Master'
item.description: The TSE rejected a request to remove a video from Lula's campaign calling Flávio Bolsonaro a 'Master liar'. The decision keeps the post under review regarding allegations against the PL candidate.

item.title: Confisco de panela no panelaço é ensaio para celular de jornalista em 2027
item.description: A doorman and a resident were arrested for using a pan during a 'pan protest' against Flávio Bolsonaro while he gave an interview to Jornal Nacional in Maceió. The case was seen as a test for the confiscation of journalists' phones in 2027.

item.title: Alckmin, Haddad e Tebet participam de caminhada pró-Lula em Heliópolis
item.description: Vice-president Geraldo Alckmin and former ministers Fernando Haddad and Simone Tebet participated in a pro-Lula walk in Heliópolis, São Paulo, engaging with residents and supporters. The event, named 'Caminhada da Virada', aims to boost Lula's performance in the second round. Alckmin received 56.6% of votes in Heliópolis in the first round, compared to 34.2% for Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Justiça rejeita pedido de advogado ligado a Flávio contra a Blaze
item.description: São Paulo's court rejected lawyer Willer Tomaz's request, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, to recover R$133.2 million lost in bets on the Blaze platform. The judge ruled that Tomaz voluntarily assumed the risks and sought special conditions to place high-value bets. The decision favored Blaze, denying compensation to the lawyer.

item.title: Flávio tem 51,2% contra 48,8% de Lula, diz Ipespe/Abrapel
item.description: A 2026 Ipespe/Abrapel poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 51.2% against Lula (PT) at 48.8% in the second round, within the margin of error. The poll, covering 1,500 voters and registered with the TSE, indicates a technical tie between the candidates.

item.title: O bolsonarista não aguenta um google
item.description: The text depicts a heated conversation between a Bolsonaro supporter and his uncle about political preferences, highlighting communication challenges across generations and ideologies. The debate touches on gun control, public safety, and cultural funding, illustrating difficulties in discussing policies based on verifiable facts.

item.title: São Paulo x Vasco no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: São Paulo and Vasco face off on Saturday, 17, at 21:00 (Brasília time) at Morumbis in the 31st round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship. São Paulo seeks stability under pressure on Dorival Júnior, while Vasco enters with an advantage from the Sudamericana. The match will be broadcast on Sportv and Premiere.

item.title: Grass promete regularização e saúde e diz que futuro do DF está em jogo
item.description: During a walk in Vila Planalto, PT candidate Leandro Grass promised to legalize land, improve healthcare and boost the local economy. He plans to issue property deeds, renovate historic buildings and turn the neighborhood into a tourist hub to create jobs and preserve the history of the Federal District.

item.title: Esperança ou medo: qual sentimento domina a disputa entre Flávio e Lula, segundo nova pesquisa Ipespe
item.description: A new Ipespe/Abrapel survey reveals hope as the dominant sentiment among voters (47%), followed by fear (15%), maintaining the trend from the previous round. Among Flávio Bolsonaro voters, hope leads with 59%, while among Lula voters, despite leading (37%), it is significantly accompanied by fear (23%).

item.title: As mentiras da Globo sobre os áudios de Vorcaro denunciando Lula
item.description: Globo and its media outlets have been discrediting a VEJA report featuring Daniel Vorcaro's audios, alleging a 30 million reais payment to Lula's Institute and funding for Oliver Stone's documentary. The Federal Police and Public Ministry issued statements to cast doubt, but Vorcaro's lawyer and sister confirmed the authenticity of the audios, backed by a forensic report showing no editing. The case was also referenced by Flávio Bolsonaro in a televised debate, where he was interrupted while discussing it.

item.title: Qual campanha está se saindo melhor nas redes, nas ruas e em entrevistas, segundo nova pesquisa Ipespe
item.description: The latest Ipespe/Abrapel poll indicates that Flávio Bolsonaro holds a slight lead over Lula across all platforms evaluated, particularly on social media, where 45% of voters consider his campaign the best. The gap between the candidates narrowed compared to the previous poll, but Flávio remains ahead on TV, radio, WhatsApp, and interviews. Lula maintains steady support but does not surpass the senator in any medium.

item.title: A boa notícia para Lula a oito dias do segundo turno na nova pesquisa Ipespe
item.description: Lula's approval rose from 43% to 45% in the latest Ipespe poll, while disapproval fell from 50% to 48%, narrowing the negative gap from 7 to 3 percentage points. Among Lula's voters, 88% approve the government, but 93% of Flávio's supporters reject it. The race remains tight, with Flávio leading 51.2% of valid votes against Lula's 48.8%.

item.title: Datafolha: 80% apoiam redução da maioridade penal
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 80% of Brazilians support reducing the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16, the lowest support level since 2003. Among Flávio Bolsonaro supporters, support reaches 89%.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Ipespe mostra quantos eleitores dizem que vão votar no segundo turno
item.description: A new Ipespe/Abrapel survey shows that 89% of voters give a score of 10 to the likelihood of voting in the runoff, with a general average of 9.5. Among those living close to their polling station, Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 51% against Lula's 45%, while among those living farther away, Lula rises to 49% against Flávio's 39%. Among the most likely voters, the split is 50% for Flávio and 46% for Lula in valid votes.

item.title: Meta admite falhas que afetaram campanha de Lula, mas nega interferência política nas eleições
item.description: Meta acknowledged technical glitches that affected Lula's campaign in the 2026 elections but denied political interference, claiming the issues were global and impacted other candidates, including Flávio Bolsonaro. The company faces a lawsuit at the TSE following reports of restrictions on ad boosting and creation of electoral images.

item.title: Verde Amarelo é nosso: veja fotos da campanha convocada por Janones
item.description: André Janones led a digital campaign urging Lula's supporters to post photos wearing green and yellow and making the 'L' hand gesture on social media. Organized by the Lula Army on WhatsApp, the initiative aims to boost support for the president in the 2026 elections against Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula participated by posting a photo wearing the Brazilian national team jersey on Instagram.

item.title: A ilusão das pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The article examines how Lula's supporters mobilized after the first round based on polls that may not reflect reality, especially with Flávio Bolsonaro's rising projections. It questions the effectiveness of strategies relying solely on voting intention data.

item.title: Ipespe: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 48% e Lula marca 46% no 2º turno
item.description: Polling by Ipespe released on October 17, 2026 shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 48% and Lula (PT) at 46% in the second round, with a margin of error of 2.6 points. The Liberal candidate's numerical lead is two points in the stimulated scenario, but within the margin, creating a tie. Among valid votes, Flávio leads with 51.2% against Lula's 48.8%.

item.title: Qual o peso do fim da escala 6×1 na escolha de voto no segundo turno, de acordo com nova pesquisa Ipespe
item.description: The new Ipespe survey shows that the end of the 6×1 scale doubled its relevance among voters, especially among young people aged 16 to 34 (33%). Among Lula voters, 20% cite the issue as the main deciding factor, while only 1% of Flávio Bolsonaro voters mention it. Corruption and crisis at the STF remain leading at 20%.

item.title: Brasil não é democracia para 16% dos eleitores, diz Datafolha
item.description: According to a Datafolha poll, 16% of Brazilian voters believe the country is not a democracy, while 50% say it has a democratic regime with major flaws. Only 7% see a fully democratic system. The survey, registered with the TSE under protocol BR-00466/2026, was conducted between October 13 and 14 with 2,520 respondents and a 2-point margin of error.
